content: For OpenAI + Anthropic + Ollama/llama.cpp classification, a thin internal Provider trait over the existing hand-rolled reqwest client beats async-openai 0.42.1 (OpenAI-only, tracks OpenAI API churn) and rig/ai-lib frameworks (heavy orchestration deps for a single classify call); Ollama and llama.cpp are OpenAI-compatible so one Chat-Completions-shaped client with per-provider base-URL + auth headers covers all three.
